summary:
Implementation plan for:
1. 100% reliable order synchronization so every order immediately appears in Admin Panel (Firestore + Express API + localStorage merge).
2. 15-minute customer order cancellation window with mandatory cancellation reason selection and stock restoration.
3. Exact post-order delivery and return policy notice displayed on both Order Confirmation and Tracking pages.
4. Comprehensive search and AI crawler enablement (Google, Meta, Gemini, Claude, GPTBot) via robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and Product Schema.org structured data, while strictly securing the Admin Panel.
